title: Integer explorer
subtitle: Pick a type and two operands, then compare the four explicit overflow strategies
fits: The result {sum} fits in {type} (range {min} … {max}). All four methods agree, and a plain a + b would also be fine.
overflows: The mathematical result {sum} does not fit in {type} (range {min} … {max}). Each method handles it differently. A plain a + b would panic in a debug build and silently wrap in release.
signedNote: Signed types use two's complement: the highest bit has negative weight (−2<sup>n−1</sup>).
